description: Fleet goal board: one row per fleet goal (owners, measured distance, next action, blocked_on, last_updated) plus a task-to-goal map. Contract page: coordinator/docs/wiki/fleet-goal-board-contract.md. The refresh op that writes it is claude-klabauter's; nothing hand-edits a live board.

board_as_of.description: When the board as a whole was last refreshed.

source_ref.description: Where the board was seeded or refreshed from (a sha, ask id or roll-call label).

stale_after_hours.description: Rows whose last_updated is older than this many hours get a stale flag.

task_map.description: Every EM open task, mapped to a goal id or FIFA. goal null means unmapped and is flagged.

flags.description: Drift flags the refresh op emits; never hand-written.

distance.description: Either the literal 'unmeasured', or a measured figure with the run id or sha that produced it. A bare 0, or a figure with no run id or sha, is invalid.

figure.description: The measured distance, e.g. '5.27/10' or '0/3 fire unaided'. A bare 0 is never a figure; use 'unmeasured'.

ref.description: Run id or sha the figure was measured at.

id.description: Goal id a task_map entry names, e.g. '1a' or 'FIFA'.

owners.description: Session handles. A goal whose owners are all dead gets a no-live-owner flag.

next.description: The action that closes the gap.

blocked_on.description: What the goal waits on, or 'none'.

goal.description: A goal id or 'FIFA'; null when the task maps to no goal.

subject.description: Goal id, or em/task_id for an unmapped task.
